stem: The times, in months, taken by a builder to build two types of house, $P$ and $Q$, are represented by the independent variables $T_1 \sim \text{N}(2.2, 0.4^2)$ and $T_2 \sim \text{N}(2.8, 0.5^2)$ respectively.

parts.label: (i)
parts.text: Find the probability that the total time taken to build one house of each type is less than 6 months.

parts.label: (ii)
parts.text: Find the probability that the time taken to build a type $Q$ house is more than 1.2 times the time taken to build a type $P$ house.
